WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    il.InvoiceId,
    c.State,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM InvoiceLine il
  JOIN Invoice i ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
  JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
  GROUP BY il.InvoiceId, c.State
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT 
    State,
    SUM(cnt) as total_cnt
  FROM step1
  WHERE State IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY State
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    s1.InvoiceId,
    s1.State,
    s1.cnt,
    CAST(s1.cnt AS FLOAT) / s2.total_cnt as quotient
  FROM step1 s1
  JOIN step2 s2 ON s1.State = s2.State
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT 
    State,
    AVG(quotient) as avg_quotient
  FROM step3
  WHERE quotient IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY State
)
SELECT 
  s3.InvoiceId,
  s3.State,
  s3.cnt,
  s3.quotient,
  s3.quotient - s4.avg_quotient as quotient_minus_avg
FROM step3 s3
JOIN step4 s4 ON s3.State = s4.State
WHERE s3.quotient > s4.avg_quotient
ORDER BY quotient_minus_avg DESC
LIMIT 10
